The largest volcano in the Ring of Fire Island Chain, '''Abaddon's Mouth''' is rumored to be the gateway into the [[Underworld]]. But only demons and devils would dare enter the fiery chasm. All other risk being burned to cinders before even getting to magma's edge.

[[Abaddon's Mouth (outpost)|Abaddon's Mouth]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. This outpost has no exit portals.

==Getting There==
*The mission [[Ring of Fire]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Abaddon's Mouth]]
**This mission is the twenty fourth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the second mission in the [[Ring of Fire Islands]] region.
